// P3 fixture corpus — stdlib-protocol conformance descriptors and witness tables.
//
// Fix P3: tryStdlibProtoConformanceSuffix handles two new suffix shapes:
//   S<letter> AA Mc/WP  — stdlib protocol, same-module conformance
//   S<letter> s  Mc/WP  — stdlib protocol, Swift-stdlib module conformance
//
// Format rules:
//   • module == "Foundation" or "Swift"  → full: <Type> : Swift.<Proto> in <Module>
//   • any other module                   → simplified: <TypeName> (module prefix stripped)
//
// All expected outputs verified against Apple swift-demangle 6.3.

// ── Foundation: full format (AAMc) ────────────────────────────────────────────

$s10Foundation10CocoaErrorVSQAAMc ---> protocol conformance descriptor for Foundation.CocoaError : Swift.Equatable in Foundation

$s10Foundation10CocoaErrorVSHAAMc ---> protocol conformance descriptor for Foundation.CocoaError : Swift.Hashable in Foundation

$s10Foundation10CocoaErrorV4CodeVSHAAMc ---> protocol conformance descriptor for Foundation.CocoaError.Code : Swift.Hashable in Foundation

$s10Foundation10CocoaErrorV4CodeVSQAAMc ---> protocol conformance descriptor for Foundation.CocoaError.Code : Swift.Equatable in Foundation

$s10Foundation10CocoaErrorV4CodeVSYAAMc ---> protocol conformance descriptor for Foundation.CocoaError.Code : Swift.RawRepresentable in Foundation
